Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill for myself as a birthday present (after a little gas-or-pellet grill debating) and I'm certainly glad I did. Easily the most even cooking grill I've ever owned. Heats up quickly to any temp I've needed so far and everything has been flavorful and beautiful (great sear marks!) 

It took me a little over an hour to assemble after taking 30 minutes or so to just lay out all the pieces. It's a sturdy unit and, even though there were numerous steps to the assembly process, it went together easily. I can say two people working together should be able to knock this out in 45 minutes or so. I also appreciate the way the packaging was done, very tidy, no dings or dents to any of the parts.

I'm a bit of a no bells and whistles guy when it comes to grilling, so even though the Genesis grills were a bit of a temptation, nobody should hesitate for a minute in purchasing the E-310. Those who are looking at the Spirit E-310 and the Spirit II E-310, just bear in mind a couple of things. The Spirit II (this grill) uses the G4 grilling system (grease pan in the middle, not offset to one side) and the Spirit II is the one that is OPEN underneath. Aesthetically for me, I like the more rugged looks of the Spirit II version of the E-310 but either grill should be fine. But, if you're like me and you need a reliable, easy-to-use gas grill (LP for me) for burgers, brats, chicken, steak, etc., I can say without a doubt the Spirit II E-310 will be a great choice!
Results.Title: A Great Entry to the Weber Grill Ecosystem

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
